#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect budget.xlsx and compute total expenses across all categories."""
import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"

sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
print("SHEETS:", list(sheets.keys()))
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"\n=== SHEET: {name} shape={df.shape} ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compute total expenses across all categories in budget.xlsx."""
import sys
import json
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name="Budget", header=None)

# Locate EXPENSES block boundaries
start = df.index[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == "EXPENSES"][0]
end = df.index[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == "Total Expenses"][0]

block = df.iloc[start + 1:end].copy()
block.columns = ["category", "item", "amount"]
block = block[pd.to_numeric(block["amount"], errors="coerce").notna()]
block["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(block["amount"])

per_category = block.groupby("category")["amount"].sum().round(2)
total = float(block["amount"].sum().round(2))

print(json.dumps({
    "per_category": {k: float(v) for k, v in per_category.items()},
    "total_expenses": total,
}, indent=2))
